benchmark_name: Turbulent Flow in a Straight Square Duct

primary_reference.citation: Pirozzoli, S., Modesti, D., Orlandi, P., & Grasso, F. (2018). Turbulence and secondary motions in square duct flow. Journal of Fluid Mechanics, 840, 634-655.
primary_reference.secondary_reference: Vinuesa, R., Noorani, A., Lozano-Duran, A., El Khoury, G. K., Schlatter, P., Fischer, P. F., & Nagib, H. M. (2014). Aspect ratio effects in turbulent duct flows studied through direct numerical simulation. Journal of Turbulence, 15(10), 677-706.
primary_reference.database_repository: Sapienza University CFD Group DNS Database (http://newton.dma.uniroma1.it/square_duct/)

reynolds_number_definitions.bulk_reynolds_number_Re_b: Re_b = U_b * D_h / nu = U_b * (2*h) / nu
reynolds_number_definitions.naming_convention_note: Canonical dataset filenames square_duct_dns_Reb{Re_b}_Retau{Re_tau}.csv explicitly specify both bulk Reynolds number Re_b and friction Reynolds number Re_tau to eliminate ambiguity between bulk (Re_b) and half-width (Re_h) definitions. The legacy labels Re1500 and Re2200 reflected earlier arithmetic miscalculations in the initial repo draft.

canonical_dimensionless_space.description: Authoritative dimensionless representation used across all comparisons, scripts, and validation metrics

dns_reference_physical_scale.description: Direct numerical simulation database scaling (Pirozzoli et al. 2018)

openfoam_cfd_physical_scale.description: Dimensional laboratory duct scale simulated in OpenFOAM (verification_squareDuct case)

reference_vortex_cores_quadrant1.description: Normalized core coordinate in quadrant y/h in [0, 1], z/h in [0, 1]

held_out_benchmark.case_name: Square Duct DNS at Re_tau = 220 (Re_b = 7000, Re_h = 3500)
held_out_benchmark.citation: Pirozzoli, S., Modesti, D., Orlandi, P., & Grasso, F. (2018). Turbulence and secondary motions in square duct flow. Journal of Fluid Mechanics, 840, 634-655.
held_out_benchmark.database_repository: Sapienza University CFD Group DNS Database (http://newton.dma.uniroma1.it/square_duct/)
